basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student currently studying business administration in the Midwest. I recently started a part-time job at CVS to help cover tuition and living expenses. When I'm not studying or working, I enjoy browsing Facebook Marketplace for vintage finds and keeping up with the latest COVID-19 vaccination news. I usually check Reddit in the evenings after classes and during lunch breaks. I'm single and living in a shared apartment with a couple of roommates. My interests include online shopping, health and wellness, and staying informed about current events.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a general knowledge of business concepts through my college courses and some practical experience gained from my part-time job. I also keep informed about COVID-19 developments and online marketplace trends through social media and news outlets.
